facts.statement: SOE's Super Fan Holidays sale ran from 18h CET on 29 November 2010 to 18h CET on 3 December 2010, with Station Cash discounts.
facts.quote: Vous pouvez profiter des réductions sur Station Cash entre 18h (CET) 29 novembre au 18h (CET) 3 décembre 2010!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post announcing the 'Les Super Fan Holidays' sale, which ran from 18h CET on 29 November 2010 to 18h CET on 3 December 2010. It describes Station Cash discounts for buyers and an extra 30% discount for Free Realms members on Station Cash items, including Dragon mounts. The post itself does not state its exact posting date; the page shows only 'Posted 6 months, 5 days ago' relative to the capture.
